title: Design: A/P info icon and tooltip match Work In Progress
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Work In Progress (Reports, then "Work In Progress" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the info icon and compare with Work In Progress's.
  2. Hover over it and look at the tooltip's position and style.
  3. Compare with Work In Progress's tooltip.
  4. Switch to dark theme and hover again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the same native report info icon, directly right of the title.
  • Step 2: the description shows in a tooltip.
  • Step 3: the same tooltip look.
  • Step 4: readable in dark theme.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R1: “Each report has the native report info icon (the one Work In Progress and Technician Utilization use) directly right of its title. Hovering, keyboard focus or a tap shows the report's description in a tooltip; moving away or Escape closes it. The descriptions:”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-open-light.png: figure "Info icon open, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-open-dark.png: figure "Info icon open, dark" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Hover, keyboard focus or a tap shows the description; moving away or Escape closes it. The longest one: "Overdue invoices, unused credit memos and deposits for each customer to help you follow up on payments. Excludes invoices that aren’t due yet." S8-R1." (caption of "Info icon open, light")
  • "Tooltip in dark mode. Descriptions appear on screen only, not in the PDF or CSV. S8-R1, S8-N1." (caption of "Info icon open, dark")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")
